What to tell your Workspace admin
Your organisation has not allowed 4Tasks

Google Workspace admins choose which apps may use their organisation’s Google accounts. Yours has not allowed 4Tasks yet. Nothing is wrong with your account. If Google showed you a message from your admin, follow it. Otherwise, send your admin the message below.
About 4Tasks
App name: 4Tasks\nPublisher: Mr-Bizzy, mr-biz.uk\nAndroid package name: %1$s%2$s
\nOAuth client ID: %1$s
What it asks Google for

One permission only: %1$s
“%2$s”

4Tasks keeps your tasks on your phone. Because you connected this account, it copies them to and from Google Tasks, so it has to create, edit and delete tasks. It asks for nothing else: no email, Drive, Calendar or contacts.
What your admin does

1. In the Google Admin console, go to Menu, Security, Access and data control, API controls.
2. Click Manage app access, then Configure new app.
3. Search for 4Tasks, or for its client ID if one is shown above, and choose it. (Uploading a CSV with Type Android and Id %1$s also works.)
4. Choose who it is for, the whole organisation or an organisational unit, then set access to Limited or Specific Google data. Limited should be enough, because Google Tasks is not one of the restricted services. If you choose Specific Google data, add the permission above.
5. Save. Changes can take a while to apply.

Hello,

I would like to use the 4Tasks app on my phone to keep my tasks in step with Google Tasks, using my work Google account (%1$s). Google says our Workspace settings do not allow 4Tasks to use it yet.

What the app is
- App name: 4Tasks (a to-do list app)
- Publisher: Mr-Bizzy, mr-biz.uk
- Android package name: %2$s%3$s
- Help page for admins: %6$s

What it asks Google for
One permission only: %4$s
“%5$s”
It copies my tasks to and from Google Tasks. It does not ask for email, Drive, Calendar or contacts.

What I need you to do
In the Google Admin console: Menu, Security, Access and data control, API controls, Manage app access, Configure new app. Search for 4Tasks (or the client ID above, if there is one), then set access for me, or for my organisational unit, to Limited or Specific Google data. Limited should be enough.
Google’s guide: %7$s

Thank you.
